app.name: Communication System
auth.error.invalid_credentials: Sign-in failed. Check your username and password.
auth.error.invalid_username: That username is not allowed by the server.
auth.error.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
auth.error.rate_limited_after: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
auth.error.server: The server had a problem. Try again in a moment.
auth.error.session_expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
auth.error.storage_unavailable: This browser does not allow the app to store its data (private mode or blocked storage). Use a normal window.
auth.error.unsupported_flow: This server requires a registration step this app does not support yet.
auth.error.user_in_use: That username is taken. Choose another.
auth.error.weak_password: The server rejected that password as too weak. Choose a longer or more varied one.
auth.field.invalid_username: Use lowercase letters, digits and . _ = - / + only.
auth.login.title: Sign in
auth.password.hint: At least 8 characters. Your password is never stored on this device.
auth.recovery.body: Account password recovery is not available in this beta. Access to your encrypted message history is separate from your password: it is restored with your recovery key, which you receive when you set up a device. Keep it somewhere safe.
auth.recovery.summary: Forgot your password or lost a device?
auth.register.title: Create your account
auth.subtitle: Your account lives on this service's homeserver. Your messages are encrypted on your device.
auth.username.hint: Lowercase letters, digits and . _ = - / + only. This becomes your public address.
blocked.empty.body: You can block someone from their conversation details.
blocked.empty.title: Nobody is blocked
blocked.intro: Messages and invitations from blocked people are not delivered to any of your devices. They are not told. Blocking hides; it does not delete anything you already received, and messages sent while blocked may appear if you unblock.
blocked.title: Blocked users
blocked.unblock.body: Messages and invitations from them will be delivered again, and messages they sent while blocked may appear.
blocked.unblock.title: Unblock this person?
chat.blocked: You blocked this person. Their messages are not delivered to you.
chat.composer.label: Message
chat.composer.placeholder: Write a message (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
chat.decryptionReason.HISTORICAL_MESSAGE: sent before this device was set up
sent before this device was set up
chat.decryptionReason.MEGOLM_KEY_WITHHEL: key withheld because this device is unverified
chat.decryptionReason.OLM_UNKNOWN_MESSAG: sent before this device had the key
chat.decryptionReason.UNSIGNED_SENDER_DE: sender device not verified by its owner
chat.empty: No messages yet. Everything you send here is end-to-end encrypted.
chat.encryptionRequired: This conversation is not encrypted, so nothing can be sent in it. Messages are never sent unencrypted.
chat.identityChanged: This person's security identity has changed since you verified them. Check their devices before trusting new messages.
chat.notFound.title: Conversation not found
chat.system.encryption_enabled: End-to-end encryption is on for this conversation.
chat.undecryptable: Unable to decrypt this message on this device.
chat.unsupported: This message type is not supported yet:
chats.empty.body: Start one with someone's username or Matrix ID.
chats.empty.title: No conversations yet
chats.invite.body: This person wants to start an encrypted conversation with you.
chats.invite.label: Invitation
chats.pending: This part of messaging arrives in the next commit.
chats.sync.error: Cannot reach the server to sync. Retrying…
details.block.body: Their messages and invitations will no longer be delivered to you, on any device. This conversation stays in your list but goes quiet. They are not told. You can unblock them from Settings.
details.block.title: Block this person?
details.blocked.state: You blocked this person. Their messages and invitations are not delivered to you.
details.blocking.help: Blocking stops their messages and invitations from reaching any of your devices. They are not told, and nothing already received is deleted.
details.devices.help: Every device of theirs that can read this conversation. Not verified means their identity has not vouched for it; compare fingerprints out of band if in doubt.
details.devices.none: No encryption keys are published for this person yet.
details.encryption.help: Messages are end-to-end encrypted (Megolm) on your devices. The server stores only ciphertext. Being encrypted does not by itself prove who is on the other side.
details.leave.body: You will stop receiving messages here and the conversation leaves your list. Messages already on your devices are not erased.
details.leave.title: Leave this conversation?
details.title: Conversation details
devices.identity.help: Compare the fingerprint with what another device shows to confirm they belong to the same account.
devices.identity.title: This device
devices.intro: Every sign-in is a device with its own encryption keys. Verify your other devices so they trust each other, and sign out any you no longer use.
devices.reauth.body: Enter your password to sign out a device. It is sent to the server once and not kept.
devices.reauth.title: Confirm it's you
devices.rename.label: Device name
devices.revoke.body: The device will lose access immediately and must sign in again. Messages it already downloaded stay on that device; signing it out does not erase them.
devices.revoke.title: Sign out this device?
devices.signOutOthers.body: Every device except this one loses access immediately and must sign in again. Messages they already downloaded stay on those devices.
devices.signOutOthers.title: Sign out all other devices?
devices.title: Devices & security
error.body: The app hit an unexpected error. Reload to try again.
error.title: Something went wrong
notFound.title: Page not found
notice.backupDisabled: Encrypted message backup is turned off for this account.
notice.identityChanged: Your account's security identity changed. If you did not set up a new device or reset your keys, review your devices now.
notice.newDevice: A new device signed in to your account:
notice.userVerificationRequest: Someone wants to verify their identity with you:
notice.verificationRequest: One of your devices wants to verify with this one:
notifications.permission.help: The browser decides whether notifications may appear at all; the choice above decides what they say. They are shown only while this tab is not in front.
offline.banner: You are offline. Messages will send when you reconnect.
people.existing: You already have a conversation with this person.
people.field.empty: Enter a username or Matrix ID.
people.field.invalid: That is not a valid username or Matrix ID.
people.field.label: Username or Matrix ID
people.identityNote: A display name is not proof of who this is. Check the identifier, and verify their devices once you are in the conversation.
people.intro: Enter the username or Matrix ID of the person you want to message. Search by name arrives with discoverability settings in a later phase.
people.title: New conversation
privacy.e2ee: Direct messages are end-to-end encrypted with the Matrix protocol. The server stores only encrypted events and cannot read them.
privacy.metadata: The server can still see who talks to whom, when, message sizes, your devices' public keys, and connection details such as IP addresses. Metadata is not encrypted.
privacy.recovery: Your recovery key is the only way to restore encrypted history on a new device. We cannot recover it for you.
privacy.title: Privacy notes
privacy.webKeys: In a web browser your encryption keys are stored in the browser's storage for this site. They are protected by browser isolation, not by dedicated hardware.
privacySettings.intro: These settings change what this app sends and shows. They are stored with your account so your other devices follow them.
privacySettings.presence.help: On: the server tells people you talk to whether you are online or when you were last active. Off: this device reports itself as offline.
privacySettings.preview.help: Message content never appears in a notification. The browser also has its own permission for notifications.
privacySettings.receipts.help: Off: nobody sees when you read a message; your own devices still agree on what is unread. On: the people you talk to see "Read" under their messages.
privacySettings.serverNote: The server always sees who you talk to and when, your devices' public keys, and these settings themselves. It never sees message content.
profile.displayName.hint: Shown to people you talk to. Up to 100 characters.
profile.identifier.note: Your username is part of this identifier and cannot be changed. Share it with people who want to message you.
profile.title: Profile
security.identity.changed.help: Their identity keys were replaced after you verified them. This happens after a reset or a compromise. Compare fingerprints or verify them again before trusting new messages.
security.identity.unknown.help: Verification state is unavailable on this device.
security.identity.unverified.help: Encryption protects these messages in transit and on the server, but you have not confirmed who holds the other side. Verify them by comparing emoji to be sure.
security.identity.verified.help: You verified this person. Messages are encrypted to devices their verified identity vouches for.
settings.blocked.body: People whose messages and invitations you do not receive.
settings.devices.body: Active sessions, verification, sign out other devices.
settings.language.note: English is the only interface language in this beta; Bengali and Arabic layouts are prepared for translation.
settings.privacyNotes.body: What is encrypted, what the server can see.
settings.title: Settings
setup.done.ready: This device is set up. Your recovery key is saved and encrypted backup is on.
setup.done.restored: Your identity and encrypted history were restored on this device.
setup.done.unverified: This device is signed in but not yet verified. Verify it from one of your other devices (Settings → Devices) to use it for encrypted messages with full trust.
setup.failed.cancelled: Setup was cancelled. This device cannot send encrypted messages until setup completes.
setup.intro: Signing in is done. Now this device gets its own encryption identity so your messages can only be read on devices you control.
setup.key.confirm: I have saved my recovery key
setup.key.label: Your recovery key
setup.key.warning: If you lose this key and all your devices, your message history cannot be recovered by anyone, including us.
setup.key.why: This recovery key is the only way to restore your encrypted history on a new device. Save it somewhere safe, outside this browser.
setup.password.why: The server asks you to confirm your password before this device can publish your identity keys.
setup.restore.hint: The key you saved when you set up your first device. Spaces are ignored.
setup.restore.invalid: That recovery key is not valid for this account. Check it and try again.
setup.restore.skip: I don't have it — verify from another device
setup.restore.why: This account was already set up on another device. Enter your recovery key to restore your identity and encrypted history here, or verify this device from one of your other devices instead.
setup.step.secret_storage: Protecting your keys with a recovery key
setup.title: Secure this device
tabs.body: This account is open in another browser tab or window. To keep your encryption keys consistent, only one tab can run at a time.
tabs.note: The other tab will show this message instead.
tabs.title: Already open in another tab
terms.body: The terms of service are being prepared for the closed beta and will appear here before the first release. Until then this software is for development and testing only.
terms.title: Terms of service
verify.cancelled.mismatch: The emoji did not match, so this device was not verified. If you did not expect this, sign that device out from Devices & security.
verify.cancelled.other: Verification did not complete. The device stays unverified.
verify.cancelled.user: Verification was cancelled. The device stays unverified.
verify.compare: Do both devices show the same emoji?
verify.confirming: Waiting for the other device to confirm…
verify.done.body: Device verified. Both devices now trust each other's encryption keys.
verify.done.user.body: Identity verified. You confirmed this person holds the keys behind their account; their devices are now shown as verified when their identity vouches for them.
verify.incoming.body: Another of your devices asked to verify with this one. Continue only if you started this from a device you control.
verify.incoming.user.body: This person asked to verify with you. Continue only if you expect it, then compare the emoji with them over a channel you trust (a call, in person).
verify.intro: Compare these emoji with the ones shown on your other device. They must be the same, in the same order.
verify.title: Verify device
verify.user.title: Verify {name}
verify.waiting.accept: Waiting for your other device to accept the request. Open it and choose Review on the notice it shows.
verify.waiting.accept.user: Waiting for them to accept the request. They will see a notice in this conversation.
verify.waiting.start: Waiting for the other device to start the emoji comparison…
welcome.body: Messages are encrypted on your device and can only be read by the people you send them to. Not even the server can read them.
welcome.points.private: Private by default: no read receipts or discoverability unless you choose
welcome.title: Private messaging, end to end
